workarounds.symptom: User-mode manager calls return a code-less failure when the bearer exchange is refused
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(connector-core): type user-mode manager preflight failures. Target files: extensions/connector-core/smoke/manager-connect-deadline.smoke.ts, extensions/connector-core/smoke/user-manager-transport.smoke.ts, extensions/connector-core/src/manager-call.ts. A connected user-mode agent could ask its issuer for a Manager bearer, be refused, and get an error reply from `MeshAgent.run("ps", ...)` with neither a code nor an outcome. Callers had to parse the message to distinguish an exchange refusal from a connection problem. (Ref: https://github.com/Cotal-AI/Cotal/pull/8051)

Target files: implementations/cli/smoke/setup-destination.smoke.ts, implementations/cli/smoke/setup-no-connector.smoke.ts, implementations/cli/smoke/up-multi-space-render-live.smoke.ts. First-run connector reconciliation can outlast the five-minute provisioner JWT. Broker startup now mints that credential after reconciliation, without changing its lifetime or scope. (Ref: https://github.com/Cotal-AI/Cotal/pull/7978)

workarounds.symptom: Self-update makes a read-only Codex config file writable

An already-current plugin still needs no native reinstall. (Ref: https://github.com/Cotal-AI/Cotal/pull/7986)

workarounds.symptom: A read-only .codex directory after setup makes self-update and rollback fail and leaves the local space unable to start

Target files: extensions/connector-codex/smoke/setup-refresh.smoke.ts, extensions/connector-codex/src/setup.ts, .changeset/current-codex-cache.md. A Codex plugin that was already current was reinstalled during every update reconciliation. If the user had made their Codex home read-only after setup, `codex plugin add` failed even though there was nothing to refresh. The same unnecessary write also prevented reconciliation of an already-cached previous generation. (Ref: https://github.com/Cotal-AI/Cotal/pull/7583)

workarounds.symptom: Deleting a local-path extension folder after its source directory is removed makes self-update and rollback fail and deadlocks ext remove
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(cli): reconcile past missing local extensions. Target files: implementations/cli/smoke/update-set-atomic.smoke.ts, implementations/cli/src/commands/ext.ts, .changeset/missing-local-extension.md. A local-path extension can outlive its download directory because `ext add` installs a copy. If its installed folder is later deleted, npm tries to resolve the stale `file:` dependency during built-in reconciliation. That fails with ENOENT and can make both self-update reconciliation and rollback fail. (Ref: https://github.com/Cotal-AI/Cotal/pull/7578)

Target files: implementations/cli/smoke/command-kernel.smoke.ts, implementations/cli/src/commands/update.ts, packages/workspace/src/updates.ts.
